promoters.name: Binghatti Developers
promoters.description:
Binghatti Developers - one of the largest real estate developers and holding companies in the United Arab Emirates, founded in 2008 by renowned Emirati entrepreneur Drs. Hussain Binghatti along with his sons.
The company is engaged in real estate development across the UAE and has a portfolio of over 40 projects with a total investment value of AED 20 billion. The company currently operates in several areas of Dubai including Business Bay, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Al Jaddaf, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Village Circle, Liwan and Dubai Land Residence Complex. The company has bold expansion plans in the coming years, with a focus on growing its real estate portfolio in Dubai. Award-winning Binghatti Developers has established itself as an innovator in real estate development and architecture. The developer has gained credibility in the real estate sector and is listed among the top 100 real estate companies in the Middle East by Forbes. The company has won numerous awards under its belt; Gulf Real Estate - Best Real Estate Off Plan Project, MENA Green Building Awards 2018 and 2017, Cityscape Awards 2018, Arabian Property Awards 2018 and 2017, Government of Dubai - Best Real Estate Tycoon Awards are just some of the achievements Binghatti Developers has received over the years.

promoters.name: Damac Properties
promoters.description:
DAMAC Properties is a leading luxury real estate developer in Dubai and beyond, renowned for its ambitious, high-end projects. Founded in 2002, it has built a strong reputation in the UAE with a diverse portfolio of modern skyscrapers, exclusive villas, hotels, and commercial properties, all featuring innovative designs and exceptional quality.  

The company collaborates with top fashion brands like Versace and Fendi to create unique interiors. It also develops luxury residential complexes around world-class golf courses. With a commitment to quality and innovation, DAMAC Properties continues to strengthen its market position, attracting both local and international investors seeking luxury and comfort.

promoters.name: DarGlobal
promoters.description: DarGlobal is a developer profoundly subscribed to the timeless value of luxury, a form of wealth that consistently appreciates in intrinsic value, representing one of the most prudent and forward-thinking investments in contemporary times. Established in 2017 to revolutionize the global luxury real estate market, integrates experience and innovation to deliver properties of the highest quality. The homes curated by DarGlobal are the product of world-class architects and are modeled by renowned design and fashion icons. Each residence is constructed with superior materials and maintained by top experts within the field. It is a pioneer in identifying the most prestigious and attractive locations, thereby providing lucrative investment opportunities for a select clientele. With a team of specialists in the luxury second home market, it operates from 10 offices worldwide. The company is unmatched in the industry, venturing into new frontiers by selecting quintessential, handpicked locations across the world’s major capitals. These efforts are complemented by exclusive collaborations with eminent brands such as Missoni, W Hotels Worldwide, Versace Home, Elie Saab, Pagani, and Lamborghini. Offerings are distinguished by their boldness and sophistication, delivering unparalleled quality in every engagement. By combining extensive experience, profound knowledge, and innovative practices with world-class talent in various fields, consistently creates unparalleled vacation homes.

promoters.name: Select Group
promoters.description:
Select Group is one of the largest developers in the UAE, which operates in the emirates of Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah and Abu Dhabi, as well as in Europe and the United Kingdom. The company was founded in 2002 and specializes in the construction of various high-end facilities, offering a wide range of real estate, from apartments and villas to office buildings and shopping malls.
The developer is known for his innovative approach to design, the use of modern technologies and high quality standards. The company has a good reputation in the Dubai real estate market and is a popular choice among buyers and investors.
A special feature of the company is the independent design of the entire recreational infrastructure within walking distance of residential complexes.
In addition to the construction of luxury real estate, the company executes orders for the construction of business centers and hotel complexes. The company's portfolio already includes more than 30 projects.
The high quality of construction, cooperation with well-known designers and competent positioning led to the fact that in 2011 Select Group became the main partner of the Intercontinental hotel group in the UAE.
One of the most famous projects of the company is the Marina Gate high-rise building, which is a modern residential complex on the Dubai waterfront. Select Group is also working on other major projects in the Dubai Marina, Business Bay and Downtown Dubai areas.
